messages:
alex (releases): FYI nightly canary in eu-central shows a small but consistent increase in 99p latency for runtime 2.18.0 with model fast-small. Proposing temporary model routing to fast-small-stable for a tiny cohort while we triage.

tess (runtime): saw the traces. not catastrophic but tail up ~30%. model fallback for canary is low risk.

mike (sdk): heads-up: clients specifying model explicitly unaffected. I'll add a blurb to release-notes indicating fallback for default routing.

sre-jo: set abort thresholds: 99p > 1.8x baseline or error rate delta > 0.03%. auto-unpin and page oncall.

deploy-bot: Suggested command ready: `pin model fast-small --to fast-small-stable --region eu-central-1 --cohort canary-mini --duration 3h`

alex (releases): proposed schedule: start 02:20 UTC, monitor 30m, then decide blended ramp. runbook snippet in thread?

tess (runtime): runbook OK. I'll enable binding traces for cohort for 10m after pin.

mike (sdk): :thumbsup: drafting short release note. will push to drafts.

sre-jo: alerts wired, auto-abort in place.

deploy-bot: Action scheduled: `pin model fast-small -> fast-small-stable` at 02:20 UTC (eu-central-1, cohort: canary-mini). Will post metrics at 02:55 UTC.

alex (releases): approvals: @tess, @mike, @sre-jo. please react with :white_check_mark:.

tess (runtime): :white_check_mark:

mike (sdk): :white_check_mark:

sre-jo: :white_check_mark:

alex (releases): thanks team  moving to execute. if any abort, call #incidents immediately.
